## Why

v8 assumes the orchestrator is an LLM agent briefed with `ai relay-orchestrator`. ork's engine is a deterministic orchestrator: it spawns roles, records the ledger and stops on the stop rules in code. The retrospective (R3) found most of the run's friction in the LLM orchestrator layer: broken no-cd rules, empty hand-backs, an API error mid-gate (S33), fragile headless resume. The contract has no statement of what a program must do to conform, so ork restates the contract in its own docs, and the two drift. s379 (`check_command`) and s387 (pin) already expose parts as JSON.
